title: The Bird of Folklore
summary: From ancient Scandinavia to the shores of the Mediterranean, the golden bird of song and folklore has flown across centuries....
full_text:
From ancient Scandinavia to the shores of the Mediterranean, the golden bird of song and folklore has flown across centuries.

It nests in the thatched cottages of peasants, sings in the workshops of weavers, and inspires the studies of poets. Tyrants have tried to cage it, and cynics have tried to shoot it down with ridicule; but with a flap of its wings, it rises higher into the azure sky, carrying the eternal myths, hopes, and dreams of mankind.
moral: The sacred bird of folklore never dies; it soars across centuries to keep the soul of humanity alive.
